actors.name: Transport Committee Chair
actors.private_context: The Chair is responsible for setting the committee's agenda and scheduling public hearings. They are aware of the sixty-day window for scheduling a hearing on the rail franchise bill. The Chair has not yet decided whether to schedule a hearing.

actors.name: Transport Committee Members
actors.private_context: The committee members have varying opinions on the rail franchise bill. Some may push for a hearing, others may oppose it. They can vote on scheduling if the Chair brings it to a vote.

shared_context: The Republic of Valdoria's parliamentary transport committee is considering the rail franchise bill. The committee's rules allow a sixty-day window from the bill's referral to schedule a public hearing. The bill was referred to the committee on 2026-07-15, so the window ends on 2026-09-13. The committee has not yet scheduled a hearing as of the simulation start time.

starting_events.description: The transport committee is in session. The Chair has the agenda for the day, which does not include scheduling a hearing on the rail franchise bill.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the transport committee scheduled a public hearing on the rail franchise bill on or before 2026-09-13T23:59:59+03:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff of 2026-09-30T18:00:00+03:00.
